rdfs:label: MemberSubject
rdfs:comment: An LDP constant used as the value of `ldp:insertedContentRelation`, meaning the member in each membership triple is the newly created resource itself — the default behaviour for all LDP containers.
notes: Upstream `ldp:MemberSubject` is an individual (a constant value), not a class; it is typed `rdfs:Class` here only because the registry schema has no individual type. It is the implicit value of `ldp:insertedContentRelation` for every Basic and Direct container, and the typical explicit value on an IndirectContainer when the new resource itself should be the member rather than a resource it points to.

history.note: Reworded definition/notes: MemberSubject is an LDP constant and the default insertedContentRelation, not a niche marker class.
